errors_it_might_very_well_belong_to_the_: It might very well belong to the Abyss.
errors_the_address_may_be_mistyped_or_if: The address may be mistyped, or if you followed a shared link, it may have been cut short on its way here. Share links are long, and chat apps sometimes trim them.
errors_a_star_slipped_its_course_tonight: A star slipped its course tonight. Sumeru’s star-readers logged the deviation, reset their instruments, and looked again.
errors_this_was_a_site_error_not_somethi: This was a site error, not something you did wrong. Reloading often clears it. If it keeps happening, please report it and say what you were doing when it broke.
